verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own docs say you can track work with issues and labels, and issues can also be managed from the CLI, imported from GitHub, and trigger webhooks. Nothing in the pack mentions assigning issues to people, and the issue docs are only one-line summaries. missing for 10: documented issue assignees, in-depth issue-tracking docs (issue types or templates for bugs, features and requirements), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bugs, features, and requirements as issues with labels and assignees

citations.quote: Track work with issues, pin and lock, labels and milestones.
Manage repositories, issues, and pull requests with the Cafe CLI.
Bring repositories from GitHub into GitCafe with their issues, pull requests, reviews and comments
